en.title: AI Act, Maltese version: Article 73(7) refers to Article 3, point (44)(c), which does not exist
en.summary: The other 23 versions refer to Article 3, point (49)(c): a serious incident that infringes obligations under Union law intended to protect fundamental rights. Point (44) defines publicly accessible space and has no point (c). Maltese Article 3, point (49)(c), and the reference in Maltese Article 73(10) support the intended reading.
en.impact: A market surveillance authority that reads only Maltese Article 73(7) is pointed, for the incidents after which it must inform the bodies under Article 77(1), to a definition that does not exist.
en.correction: Replace point (44)(c) with point (49)(c) in Maltese Article 73(7).

mt.title: L-Att dwar l-Intelliġenza Artifiċjali, verżjoni Maltija: l-Artikolu 73(7) jirreferi għall-Artikolu 3, il-punt (44)(c), li ma jeżistix
mt.summary: It-23 verżjoni l-oħra jirreferu għall-Artikolu 3, il-punt (49)(c): inċident serju li jikser obbligi taħt il-liġi tal-Unjoni maħsuba biex jipproteġu d-drittijiet fundamentali. Il-punt (44) jiddefinixxi spazju aċċessibbli għall-pubbliku u m'għandux punt (c). L-Artikolu 3, il-punt (49)(c), u r-referenza fl-Artikolu 73(10) tal-verżjoni Maltija jappoġġaw il-qari intenzjonat.
mt.impact: Awtorità tas-sorveljanza tas-suq li taqra biss l-Artikolu 73(7) Malti tintbagħat, għall-inċidenti li warajhom trid tinforma lill-korpi taħt l-Artikolu 77(1), għal definizzjoni li ma teżistix.
mt.correction: Il-punt (44)(c) jinbidel bil-punt (49)(c) fl-Artikolu 73(7) tal-verżjoni Maltija.
